what: The decko-ts standing verification net: every live file of the fold-verification net, reconciled into ONE checked-in list. Submit it as a single machine test queue job with the runner (see canonicalCommand).

provenance.howToRead: Each entry below records what a group of listed files covers and the date its coverage was verified. The `files` list is the net itself; the entries here say why a file is in it, so a file that goes stale is traceable to the coverage it was added for.
sources: Full-fold coverage sweep (55-filter command; 546 passed / 4 expected fail / 11 skipped / 0 failed): 50 of its filters name files that exist in this tree and are listed below; the other 5 matched nothing and are recorded under droppedDeadFilters

Real-path coverage sweep (11 files): 10 of its paths exist in this tree and are listed below; tests/card/rules/nest-miss-unknown-view-selection-corpus-replay.test.ts has no git history on this line and is not listed; tests/card/mod-loader/card-mod-format.test.ts was already covered

Write-path suites (five files), added 2026-10-01: these sat outside the manifest, which let a decoy-shape change rot the renamegate suite unnoticed until the suite was swept separately; listed so the net guards them. Verified green at the fold tip: 32/32

Collision-order pins (tests/card/mod-loader/view-dispatch-same-pattern-collision-order.test.ts), added 2026-10-01: four suites, kept byte-identical so the before/after comparison is like-for-like. Verified at the fold tip: 99 passed / 1 expected fail
Anchored-arm format-scope census (tests/card/mod-loader/view-dispatch-anchored-cross-format-collision-census.test.ts), added 2026-10-01 so the net guards the zero-collision adjudication
Flat-table format-scope census (tests/card/mod-loader/view-dispatch-flat-record-format-scope-census.test.ts), added 2026-10-01 so the net guards the flat-record format filter
Select-editor suite (tests/card/mod-loader/card-mod-list-select-editor.test.ts), added 2026-10-02 so the net guards the editor port; its bytes are derived from the ActionView gems

Surface-scoped decko.rootUrl pin (tests/card/render/deck-origin-surface-scoped-root-url.test.ts), added 2026-10-02: head_javascript.rb:35 card_url("") is Env.origin + card_path("") and Env.origin is per-render (env/serializable.rb:20-22), so the view lane carries / and the page lane carries the capture deck_origin. page.ts#scriptVariablesTag interpolated the DECK_ORIGIN constant; the bare-view-lane seat (render.ts:1385) reaches the same builder and emitted the page-surface bytes on cards 34754/34758 (+24). Listed so the net guards the surface split in both directions.

Delegated-render rescue scope (tests/card/render/date-delegated-core-rescue-scope-pins.test.ts), added 2026-10-02: every render! in Ruby is independently rescued (card/lib/card/format/render.rb:7-14, :96-100) and render_core from inside a view body is a NEW render! (format/method_delegation.rb:41-47), so a raising delegated core RETURNS the render-error span, the enclosing wrap still emits its card-slot div, and the error is labelled with the DELEGATED view (format/error.rb:80-86). The Date arm of the dispatch gate sat one level too high and skipped the view body, so a nested +Date lost its slot. Listed so the net guards the nested surface (wrapped, quiet, core-labelled) AND the focal surface (still re-raises) together.
